1972 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
From 1972-12-02, add 356 days:  
First, 29 days left in Dec → 1972-12-31.  
Remaining days: 356 − 29 = 327 days.  
1973 is not a leap year. Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) + Sep (30) = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 273 days into 1973.  
327 − 273 = 54 days left in October 1973. October has 31 days, so 54 − 31 = 23 days into November.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1973-11-23
